title: Identifying potential active ingredients from pomegranate in treating anemia: CPA3 and SOX4 are key proteins.
authors: Huang, Zhuang; Wang, Shanshan; Wen, Yuxin; Jiang, Qi; Tang, Yiting; Duan, Bailu; Wang, Qiong; Li, Jinjin; Han, Lintao; Huang, Fang; Huang, Bisheng
one_liner_zh: 该文通过WGCNA和机器学习筛选贫血关键蛋白SOX4/CPA3，并用分子对接与MD模拟预测石榴活性成分，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接而非TF-DNA互作，但MD/对接方法可迁移，对象偏离核心。
abstract: Fanconi anemia is a rare hereditary blood disorder that usually manifests as bone marrow failure, dysplasia, cancer susceptibility and anemia. Pomegranate, as a "secret" for people in Xinjiang, China and India, is commonly used for treating different types of anemia. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to identify potential proteins of FA and to discover potential drugs from pomegranates. METHODS: Firstly, we downloaded gene expression datasets of myeloid cells from FA patients from the GEO database and screened for key differential genes using weighted gene co-expression network analysis and machine learning algorithms. Next, subcellular localization and external validation datasets were used to verify the reliability of genes. Finally, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation were used to predict potential drugs for treating FA with pomegranate. RESULTS: After screening by WGCNA and machine learning algorithms and an external validation set, SOX4 and CPA3 were retained and were highly expressed in erythroid cells of the bone marrow. Based on the above two protein structures, coumaric acid 4-O-glucoside (-8.212 Kcal/mol) and kaempferol-3-O-neohesperidoside (-7.128 Kcal/mol) were screened. CONCLUSION: SOX4 and CPA3 can be considered as key proteins of FA, coumaric acid-4-O-glucoside and kaempferol-3-O-neohesperidin have been found to have therapeutic potency for FA.
abstract_zh: 范可尼贫血是一种罕见的遗传性血液疾病，通常表现为骨髓衰竭、发育异常、癌症易感性和贫血。石榴作为中国新疆和印度人民的“秘方”，常用于治疗不同类型的贫血。目的：本研究旨在识别范可尼贫血的潜在蛋白质，并从石榴中发现潜在药物。方法：首先，我们从GEO数据库下载了范可尼贫血患者髓系细胞的基因表达数据集，并使用加权基因共表达网络分析和机器学习算法筛选关键差异基因。接下来，利用亚细胞定位和外部验证数据集来验证基因的可靠性。最后，采用分子对接和分子动力学模拟预测石榴治疗范可尼贫血的潜在药物。结果：通过WGCNA、机器学习算法及外部验证集的筛选，保留了SOX4和CPA3，并在骨髓红系细胞中高表达。基于上述两种蛋白质结构，筛选出香豆酸4-O-葡萄糖苷（-8.212 Kcal/mol）和山柰酚-3-O-新橙皮苷（-7.128 Kcal/mol）。结论：SOX4和CPA3可被视为范可尼贫血的关键蛋白质，香豆酸-4-O-葡萄糖苷和山柰酚-3-O-新橙皮苷被发现具有治疗范可尼贫血的潜力。
